# Local Trrack demo bundle

Trrack 1.3.0, bundled from the existing lockfile installation for browser ESM use.
Regenerate with `node scripts/sync-demo-trrack.mjs` after installing locked dependencies.
No remote imports or runtime package downloads. See trrack-NOTICES.txt for bundled dependency versions and licenses.
The Trrack package omits its license file; trrack-LICENSE.txt preserves the publisher license from https://github.com/Trrack/trrackjs/blob/main/LICENSE (read September 9, 2026).
